params.evidence: 'OneCoin sold paid trust in a coin nobody could check'; no scene can be cut.

params.evidence: The close opens a new plot event (the vanishing) before landing the idea.

params.evidence: Every name, date and figure has a verified fact with a specific source.

params.evidence: 2.3 to 2.5 words per second; short active sentences.
